name: Binance delta-neutral funding harvest: spot long + perp short when rate above threshold
author: Leewonwuk
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
indicators: Funding rate (8h), spot and perp prices
entry_long: Open equal-notional spot long and perp short when funding rate per 8h >= min_funding_rate (example config 0.0003 = 0.03%/8h ~ 13% annualized; README entry rule: annualized funding > fee breakeven, typical target > 20%).
exit: Close both legs after max_position_hold_hours (example 72h); funding_strategy.py monitors threshold (exit-on-rate-decay not stated in README).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Code complete but standby per README (not live); README gives config example but not the exact exit-on-low-funding rule.
